findings: YouTubeWorkspace already offers text-button playback inside its floating detail. This batch improves that existing entry; it is not a claim to add previously absent playback.
The initial floating preview is an inert thumbnail. The visible central play entry is missing, unlike the expected video interaction.
VOD uses the original YouTube iframe; live uses the shared local-HLS player. Replacing live with an independent official iframe plus recorder violates the retained single-ingress requirement.

Before editing YouTubePlayer, two new focused regression tests failed on2026-10-14: a late initialDelivery/onReady erased an already verified onError153, and the600ms subscription continued after its20second timeout (132messages at timeout,200after another10seconds). Latch that attempt's failure until explicit retry and stop its handshake timer; do not replace original controls or assert successful playback from readiness.
scope: Add a centered native play button over the floating preview. Only its actual button hitbox starts playback; surrounding thumbnail, card single-click, tab changes and focus do not start anything.
Keep the header play/stop action and all existing favorite/download/detail/minimize actions. Central activation is idempotent and never toggles an already-started stream off after a repeated click.

Use native button keyboard behavior and the existing dialog focus loop. Privacy disables revealing playback. Preserve the existing4-player cap and show its error inside the floating detail instead of only behind its backdrop.

Keep the existing official VOD iframe, connection indicator, bounded timeout and retry/error surface. Add focused protocol regressions and only correct an evidenced readiness/error race if reproduced.
Keep each existing player node/lease across detail minimize, viewing route and platform visibility changes. Do not add another iframe/native receiver for the central button.

acceptance: Detail opens with an obvious centered play button without playback, download or navigation side effects.
Clicking the thumbnail outside that button does nothing; native Enter/Space activation and focus visibility remain available.
Central activation opens one official VOD iframe in the same dialog without changing navigation, and repeated activation does not stop or duplicate it.
Live central activation mounts exactly one current native receiver; no official iframe or download starts in parallel.
Privacy disables central/header playback and masks the cover; a fifth stream shows a visible in-detail capacity error and retains the existing four.
Loading/error/retry are visible inside the player. Spoofed or stale-frame messages cannot clear errors or claim readiness.
Existing minimize/tab/platform lifecycle tests pass unchanged. Actual app VOD/live playback, original control appearance, pixel hitboxes and keyboard operation remain manual verification gates.
